project_type: Node.js/Express backend + FastAPI AI service + React/Vite frontend (monorepo)
build_system: backend: node directly, no build step; frontend: Vite (npm run build); ai-service: uvicorn directly, no build step
test_framework: No test framework configured. Verification uses: node --check (JS syntax), python -m py_compile (Python syntax), npm run build in frontend/ (Vite compile).
test_command: node --check <file>  (backend); python -m py_compile <file>  (ai-service); cd frontend && npm run build  (frontend)
verification_instructions: 1. For each new backend JS file: run `node --check <filepath>` from the workspace root — must exit 0. 2. For each new Python file: run `python -m py_compile <filepath>` from workspace root — must exit 0. 3. After all changes: run `cd frontend && npm run build` — must complete with 0 errors (warnings about unused imports are acceptable).
environment_constraints: Working directory for all commands is c:\Users\umavy\OneDrive\Desktop\kiro\campus-guardian-360. Frontend build output goes to frontend/dist (not checked in). No dev server should be started. Python version is 3.10 (confirmed from __pycache__ filenames).
contribution_requirements: All backend routes use authenticate + authorize + auditLog middleware from backend/src/middleware/auth.js. All controllers return { success, message?, data? }. All services call AI service via axios with AI_SERVICE_URL() = process.env.AI_SERVICE_URL || 'http://localhost:8000'. Frontend uses api.js axios instance (baseURL = VITE_API_URL || 'http://localhost:5000/api'). Socket.IO server exposed via app.set('io', io) in server.js.
key_patterns: Backend models: Mongoose schema with pre-save updatedAt hook, explicit index declarations, .lean() on queries. Backend routes: require express Router, chain middleware, call controller. Backend controllers: async function, try/catch, return res.status(N).json({ success, message, data }). Frontend services: import api from './api', export async functions calling api.get/post/patch. Frontend pages: functional components with useState/useEffect/useCallback, Tailwind classes, lucide-react icons, Recharts for charts. Frontend uses react-router-dom v6 (Routes/Route/Navigate/NavLink/useNavigate). AuthContext exposes { user, token, login, logout, loading } via useAuth() hook.
directory_structure: campus-guardian-360/ — root. backend/src/: server.js (Express+Socket.IO entry), models/, routes/, controllers/, services/, middleware/, config/. ai-service/app/: main.py (FastAPI entry), agents/ (8 agents), routers/ (analysis/patterns/actions/evaluation/outcomes), core/ (model_manager/schemas/config). frontend/src/: App.jsx (router), main.jsx, pages/admin/ (6 pages exist), pages/user/ (4 pages), pages/safeguarding/ (empty dir), context/, services/, components/. data/: synthetic dataset. docs/: architecture docs.
